array.string: set -e d="${DOTFILES_DIR:-$(for l in "$HOME/.zshrc" "$HOME/.agent/AGENTS.md" "$HOME/.claude/settings.json"; do t=$(readlink "$l" 2>/dev/null) || continue; r=$(cd "$(dirname "$t")/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd) || continue; [ -d "$r/scripts" ] && printf %s "$r" && break; done)}" [ -n "$d" ] || { echo "llmwiki-web: dotfiles checkout not found" >&2; exit 1; } py= for c in "$HOME/.pyenv/shims/python3" /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 "$(command -v python3 2>/dev/null)"; do [ -x "$c" ] || continue "$c" -c "import tomllib" 2>/dev/null || continue py="$c"; break done [ -n "$py" ] || { echo "llmwiki-web: no python3 with tomllib (needs 3.11+)" >&2; exit 1; } cd "$d" exec "$py" -m scripts.llmwiki serve --port 8391 --refresh 60
